usedFor: Teachfloor runs your cohort courses, and MSG91 sends a mail through “Send a Mail” when “Course Updated” runs.

bestTemplate.name: “Course Updated” in Teachfloor, then “Send a Mail” in MSG91
bestTemplate.why: A course change can send learners a templated notice from your MSG91 account.

watchOut: A mail to learners waits in Needs you for approval, so “Send a Mail” goes out after you approve.
